title: UCP JSON Schema: ucp.json (envelope, entity base, profile and response definitions)
notes: entity requires version and defines spec, schema, id and config; status is an enum success or error with default success; the success and error branches require status.

title: UCP JSON Schema: service.json
notes: base requires transport (rest, mcp, a2a, embedded); business_schema requires endpoint for rest, mcp and a2a and a typed config for embedded; platform_schema requires spec, plus schema for rest, mcp and embedded.

title: UCP JSON Schema: capability.json
notes: business_schema requires schema; platform_schema requires spec and schema; extends may be a string or an array.

title: UCP JSON Schema: payment_handler.json
notes: base requires id; platform_schema also requires spec and schema; available_instruments optional with minItems 1.

title: UCP JSON Schema: common/loyalty.json (dev.ucp.common.loyalty)
notes: Multi-parent extension of catalog search, catalog lookup, cart and checkout.
